title: fieldwork-db::books_db — book metadata, shelves, reviews, ratings
description: DB module for book tracking: books (title, author, isbn, cover_url, openlibrary_id), editions, shelves (user reading status: to-read/reading/read with dates), reviews (text + rating 1-5), reading_progress (page/percentage). Uses OpenLibrary API for book metadata lookup.
close_reason: Bookwyrm mode complete. books_db (4 tables, 18 tests), bookwyrm_api types+routes (17 tests). Schema migration v10.
